book.name: 1 K'oronttoosa
book.title: P'awuloosi K'oronttoosa Asaw S'aafeedda Koyro Kiitaa

content: Eek'aw yarshsheedda k'umaabaa gidooppe, nuuni ubbaykka ereetto. Eray otorssee; shin siik'uu ammanuwaan dichchee.
Ooninne barew ittibaa eriyaawaa malatooppe, I biro eranaw bessiyaawaa eribeenna.
Shin ooninne S'oossaa siik'ooppe, S'oossay Aa eree.
Hewaa diraw, eek'aw yarshsheedda k'umaa muussaabaa gidooppe, eek'aa ubbay alamiyaan ayaanne gidennawaanne, itti S'oossaappe attin, haray baynnawaa nuuni ereetto.
Ayaw gooppe, c'ora s'oossatuunne c'ora godatuu de'iino. Shin haray atto, saluwaan gidina sa'aan gidina, s'oossatuwaa geetettiyaawanttu de'ooppekka,
ubbabaa med'd'eeddawe nuuni aw de'iyaawe, itti S'oossay, Aawuu, nuw de'ee. K'ay ubbabay aan med'etteeddawenne nuuni aan de'iyaawe itti Goday, Yesuusi Kiristtoosikka nuw de'ee.

Shin ha eray asaa ubbaw de'enna. Itti itti asatuu eek'aa dooyeedda diraw, ha"i gakkanawukka, «Eek'aw yarshsheedda k'umaa» yaagiidde miino. K'ay unttunttu wozanay shuga gideeddawaan, unttunttoo ha k'umaan tuneeddawaa malatee.
Shin k'umay nuuna S'oossaakko shiik'anaadan maaddenna. Nuuni maana d'ayinttokka nuw ayinne pac'c'enna; mooppenne nuw ayinne gujettenna.
Shin hawe hintte hintte dosowaadan haniyaawe shugo ammanuwaanna de'iyaawantta nagaraan yeggenna mala naagettite.

Ayaw gooppe, neeni eranchchay eek'aw yarshsheedda k'umaa maanaw eek'aa golliyaan utteedda wode, shugo ammanuwaanna de'iyaa itti Asay neena be'ooppe, eek'aw yarshsheedda k'umaa I maanaw Aa wozanay k'oppenneeyee?
Hewaa gidooppe ha shugo ammanuwaanna de'iyaa ne ishay, Kiristtoosi Aa diraw hayk'k'eeddawe, ne eraan bayee.
Hawaadankka, hintte hintte ishatuwaa naak'k'iyaawaaninne unttunttu shugo wozanaa maytsiyaawaan Kiristtoosa naak'k'iita.
Hewaa diraw, k'umay ammaniyaa ta ishaa d'ubbiyaawaa gidooppe, Aa d'ubbenna mala, ta de'iyaa laytsaan mulekka ashuwaa miikke.
